sections.Profile:
"Cosmic Flash" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Bell Games, an Italian manufacturer, in 1984. The game features a space fantasy theme, with backglass artwork inspired by the 1983 Italian film "2019: After the Fall of New York." The playfield includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, six standup targets, a three-bank drop target, a kick-out hole, and three in-line drop targets

- Manufacturer: Bell Games
- Years made: 1984–1985
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Space Fantasy, Original Theme, Solid State, Guns, Action, 1980s
